headline: A hidden character sitting in the note editor's file made our code search tool skip that entire file without saying so. It is gone now, and the tool sees the file.
matters: The note editor is the biggest and busiest screen in the app, the one where you place and drag notes. Every time anyone searched the app's code looking for a problem, that screen was silently left out and the search still reported back clean. So some past clean answers had never actually looked there. I reran the main one and it is still clean, meaning nothing was in fact hiding, but the answer is now trustworthy rather than lucky. Nothing about how the app looks or behaves changed.
detail: src/components/PianoRoll.tsx held the only NUL byte in any source file in the tree, at offset 32584, inside the sentinel MIXED_VOICE. grep classifies a file containing NUL as binary and skips it: grep -c MIXED_VOICE exited 1 with no output where grep -ac returned 7. Fix spells the sentinel as the escape \0mixed instead of a raw byte, so the runtime string is unchanged (\0mixed === String.fromCharCode(0)+'mixed' is true, length 6, codepoint 0) and it still cannot collide with a real voice id. Re-ran the sweep that produced audit finding F15: 11 localStorage hits, none in PianoRoll.tsx, so F15's conclusion holds. Also re-checked the gesture-reachability sweep against this file: openRegionIdRef at line 219 is a correct guard on async fetch continuations across a region switch, not a defect. Confirmed still present and NOT fixed here, booked under README-7: the stale 'Draw Mode (F6)' comment at line 118 where the binding is B. Merged tree lanes all green, exit codes read directly: cargo 264 passed 0 failed, npm run build clean with zero warnings, vitest 352 passed across 33 files, no src/bindings.ts drift.
